Ingrid Solberg — CV bullets (Senior Backend Engineer, Payments Platform — Ledgerbridge Financial)

Senior Applied Scientist, Perception Team — Northcairn Robotics (Mar 2021 - Present)
- Own the object-detection model running on the company's warehouse robot fleet end to end, from data collection through production deployment — sole technical owner of a system the fleet depends on daily.
- Led migration of the production perception stack from a two-stage to a single-stage detector architecture in PyTorch, cutting inference time on the robots' onboard hardware.
- Review and sign off model-release documents ahead of every quarterly firmware update, acting as the release gate for changes shipping to production hardware.
- Contributed to the team's active-learning pipeline for prioritising which warehouse images get labelled next, and presented the results at the company's internal research seminar.
- Filed a patent with two co-inventors on detecting reflective surfaces in warehouse aisles.
- Mentor two junior applied scientists on the perception team on an ongoing, informal basis (no formal reporting line or budget authority).

Applied Scientist, Perception Team — Northcairn Robotics (Sep 2018 - Mar 2021)
- Carried on-call for the perception service through fleet pilot deployments, diagnosing and resolving live production issues on customer sites.
- Cut false-positive detections on reflective packaging by building a targeted hard-negative dataset and retraining the production model.
- Co-authored the internal technical report on perception failure modes that the hardware team used to reprioritise camera placement — translating a subtle software failure mode into decisions made outside my own team.
- Built the first version of the label-review tool used day-to-day by external data annotation contractors.
- Worked on multi-camera calibration across the warehouse robot fleet.

Machine Learning Engineer — Fenwick Vision Systems (Jul 2014 - Sep 2018)
- Built and maintained the quarterly retraining pipeline for the company's production defect-detection model.
- Deployed the defect-detection model to inspection stations on the factory floor, and ported inference code from a GPU server to a lower-power embedded board for a pilot deployment.
- Authored the model card and evaluation report that the QA team used to sign off each model release — the formal handover artefact between engineering and a non-engineering review function.
- Root-caused a production accuracy regression to an undocumented change in the camera lighting rig, and communicated the finding back to the hardware owners.
- Trained two new hires on the team's model evaluation process.

Research Engineer — Aldermoor Institute for Applied AI (Sep 2010 - Jun 2014)
- Published two peer-reviewed workshop papers on convolutional feature extraction for small-object detection; presented a poster at a workshop of roughly forty attendees.
- Built the lab's shared dataset-loading library, adopted by three other research projects in the group.
- Collaborated with the robotics group on real-time inference under hard compute constraints.
- Wrote the lab's internal guide to reproducible experiment tracking.

Technical profile
- Production code in Python and C++; PyTorch for model development.
- Production deployment experience is to on-premise robots and factory hardware rather than cloud-facing services; no Go, Java backend service, Kafka, Rust, or payments/PCI-DSS experience to date.

job.raw_text:
Senior Backend Engineer, Payments Platform
Ledgerbridge Financial - Remote (UK/EU)

About Ledgerbridge

Ledgerbridge Financial builds settlement infrastructure for mid-sized merchants across
Europe. We process a lot of money on behalf of businesses who need to trust that it
moves correctly, every time. Our platform team owns everything from card-network
integration to nightly settlement, and we're growing it.

The role

We're looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join our Payments Platform team. You'll
work on the systems that move money between merchants, card networks, and banks, and
you'll be one of the people the rest of engineering leans on when a payment doesn't
reconcile. This is a hands-on engineering role, not a management track.

What you'll do

- Design and build services in the core settlement and reconciliation path
- Take ownership of at least one production service end to end
- Be part of the on-call rotation for payment-critical systems
- Work closely with the risk and compliance teams on how we handle sensitive data
- Help less experienced engineers on the team grow

What you'll need

- 5+ years building backend services in Go, Java, or a similar statically typed language
- Experience with Kafka or a comparable message broker in production
- Familiarity with PCI-DSS or a similar compliance framework, even if you weren't the
  one formally responsible for it
- On-call experience for production systems where money is on the line
- Experience mentoring other engineers
- A strong communicator who can explain a tricky bug to someone outside the team

Nice to have

- Prior experience at a fintech, payments, or banking company
- Rust experience
- Experience managing a team's infrastructure or cloud budget
- Conference speaking experience
- Comfortable working in a company with 200+ engineers

Benefits & perks

Competitive salary and equity, private health cover, 28 days holiday plus bank
holidays, a home office stipend, and a genuinely flexible remote-first culture.
Ledgerbridge Financial is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants
regardless of background.
